style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Standing at 6ft, this tree is perfectly sized for any living room, dining room, or hallway, with ample space for all your favourite decorations. Designed with hinged branches, assembly is quick and hassle-free—simply connect the three distinct sections, and the branches naturally fall into place. Crafted from a premium mix of PE and PVC branches, this tree provides a realistic and full appearance, with 1,900 branch tips that replicate the appearance of a Nordic spruce. This lifelike tree is a beautiful addition to your holiday celebrations for years to come.

Key Features:
• EASY ASSEMBLY WITH HINGED BRANCHES: The Charles Bentley 6ft Christmas Tree features hinged branches that automatically fall into place, making setup quick and hassle-free.
• REALISTIC FAUX BRANCHES: Crafted from a mix of high-quality PE and PVC, the branches provide a lifelike look, ensuring a traditional appearance for your holiday décor.
• FULLER LOOK WITH 1,900 BRANCH TIPS: With 1,900 branch tips, this tree offers a full and lush appearance, providing ample space for ornaments and decorations.
• NORDIC SPRUCE SHAPE: Designed to replicate the shape of a Nordic spruce, this tree adds a timeless touch to your festive setup.
• IDEAL 6FT HEIGHT: Standing at 6ft, this tree is the perfect height for most living rooms, dining areas, or hallways, creating a stunning focal point for your holiday celebrations.

Additional Information:
The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look. Images show 7ft model.

Product Specifications:
• Height: 6ft
• Girth: 48 inches
• Branch Tips: 1910
